name: AppFolio
description: AppFolio Property Manager is a cloud-based platform for managing residential real estate portfolios — multifamily, single-family, and affordable housing — covering accounting, marketing/leasing, maintenance, resident communication, and inspections, with an AI assistant (Realm-X) built in.
best_for: Property managers and real estate operators, from small portfolios to large enterprises, who want an established, full-featured platform and are comfortable with a custom-quoted price rather than public list pricing.
features: Property inspections and unit turnover tracking
API access (read-only on Plus, read/write on Max)

pricing.starting_price: Core starts at $1.49/unit/month; minimum spend and a 50-unit minimum apply

tiers.name: Core
tiers.notes: Starting rate. AppFolio states a minimum spend and 50-unit minimum apply; exact minimum spend is not published.

tiers.name: Plus
tiers.notes: Starting rate. Minimum spend and unit requirements apply.

tiers.name: Max
tiers.notes: Starting rate. Minimum spend and unit requirements apply.

pros: One of the two most-established, most-recognized names in property-management software
Deep accounting and leasing feature set proven at scale
Genuine, directly observed real-world usage disclosure among small-to-mid property managers
cons: AppFolio publishes per-unit starting rates, but also requires a minimum spend and a 50-unit minimum on Core; the exact minimum spend is quote-based.
Plus and Max also carry minimum-spend and unit requirements, so the displayed per-unit rate is not a complete monthly quote for every portfolio.
No public consumer affiliate/referral program is documented; AppFolio's partner program is aimed at vendors and consultants.

faq.question: How much does AppFolio cost?
faq.answer: AppFolio does not publish exact pricing. It offers three tiers (Core, Plus, Max) with minimum-spend and per-unit-minimum requirements, and a specific quote requires contacting AppFolio directly.

faq.question: Does AppFolio have an affiliate program?
faq.answer: AppFolio runs a Partner Program for software/hardware vendors and consulting companies, not a public consumer affiliate program of the kind Buildium or DoorLoop offer.
